# Hong Leong Connect

> Hong Leong Bank's digital banking platform offering comprehensive online banking services, payment transfers, and account management features.

Hong Leong Connect is the primary online banking portal for Hong Leong Bank customers in Malaysia, providing access to services including DuitNow, IBG transfers, ASNB investments, and various banking products like Junior Debit Card and Credit Shield Premier.
